card.name: Space before a number after weight or dose
card.fires_on: The blank space or small joining word just before a number that gives a weight, gravity or dose, often in text on gases like carbon monoxide or on rivastigmine patch strengths. It also fires weakly on words in nerve-agent and organophosphate text.
